fields.description: Issue includes coverage and commentary on the Quigg trial involving Miami police officials and jury selection, local and state politics including a Catts–Carson rally and the Florida governor’s race, and preparations for the forthcoming Shrine convention as a major tourism and business event. Also notes Prohibition-era liquor enforcement and concerns about bad liquor, local civic and labor items, and entertainment listings and advertisements.
